opportunities.title: Idle interactive sessions
opportunities.action: Warn and time out idle interactive allocations
opportunities.method: Match a MantisGrid detector to raw telemetry, assign each job to its first eligible opportunity, cap impact by measured GPU-hours, then apply scenario recovery fractions.
opportunities.basis: 906 distinct verified jobs; 36661.965 candidate GPU-hours capped by measured job GPU-hours; recovery assumptions 0%–25%.
caveats: Four-month workload sample; no cluster-wide annualization.
Recoverable fractions are policy assumptions, not measured outcomes.
Job-level allocation prevents overlap across opportunities; within-job idle intervals are unavailable.

cost_if_wrong.description: An idle timeout could terminate a useful interactive session and force a rerun. This dataset does not measure the counterfactual cost.
cost_if_wrong.mitigation: Warn first, permit an extension, pilot on a small group, and roll back if retries or complaints rise.

opportunities.title: GPU not needed
opportunities.action: Review successful CPU-only workloads for CPU placement
opportunities.method: Match a MantisGrid detector to raw telemetry, assign each job to its first eligible opportunity, cap impact by measured GPU-hours, then apply scenario recovery fractions.
opportunities.basis: 354 distinct verified jobs; 8450.712 candidate GPU-hours capped by measured job GPU-hours; recovery assumptions 0%–50%.
caveats: Four-month workload sample; no cluster-wide annualization.
Recoverable fractions are policy assumptions, not measured outcomes.
Job-level allocation prevents overlap across opportunities; within-job idle intervals are unavailable.

cost_if_wrong.description: Moving a job to CPU placement could slow it or fail if an unobserved GPU dependency exists. This dataset does not measure the counterfactual cost.
cost_if_wrong.mitigation: Canary selected jobs on CPU nodes and compare completion time and success before changing defaults.

opportunities.title: Slow cancellation of idle jobs
opportunities.action: Alert owners and add a liveness review before cancellation
opportunities.method: Match a MantisGrid detector to raw telemetry, assign each job to its first eligible opportunity, cap impact by measured GPU-hours, then apply scenario recovery fractions.
opportunities.basis: 891 distinct verified jobs; 66456.868 candidate GPU-hours capped by measured job GPU-hours; recovery assumptions 0%–25%.
caveats: Four-month workload sample; no cluster-wide annualization.
Recoverable fractions are policy assumptions, not measured outcomes.
Job-level allocation prevents overlap across opportunities; within-job idle intervals are unavailable.

cost_if_wrong.description: A premature cancellation could destroy useful progress or interrupt a hung job that might recover. This dataset does not measure the counterfactual cost.
cost_if_wrong.mitigation: Send alerts first, require owner confirmation, and measure retry and completion rates.

opportunities.title: GPU card imbalance
opportunities.action: Profile per-card work distribution before resizing
opportunities.method: Match a MantisGrid detector to raw telemetry, assign each job to its first eligible opportunity, cap impact by measured GPU-hours, then apply scenario recovery fractions.
opportunities.basis: 689 distinct verified jobs; 14558.670 candidate GPU-hours capped by measured job GPU-hours; recovery assumptions 0%–20%.
caveats: Four-month workload sample; no cluster-wide annualization.
Recoverable fractions are policy assumptions, not measured outcomes.
Job-level allocation prevents overlap across opportunities; within-job idle intervals are unavailable.
Per-card averages verify imbalance but cannot prove work can run on fewer GPUs.

cost_if_wrong.description: Removing a GPU could extend runtime or break distributed jobs. This dataset does not measure the counterfactual cost.
cost_if_wrong.mitigation: Profile and benchmark representative jobs before resizing; restore the prior allocation on regression.

findings.shortDescription: Job completed successfully without using its 1 GPU
findings.longDescription: Job 24414683 requested 1 GPU, ran for 1.1 hours and COMPLETED, with SM utilization at 0.0% for the whole job, peak included. findings.impactDescription: 1.1 GPU-hours allocated to a job that did not use them.

findings.shortDescription: Job held 2 GPUs at 3.0% for 21.5h before it was cancelled
findings.longDescription: Job 160446556 ran for 21.5 hours at a mean SM utilization of 3.0% and was then CANCELLED, consuming 43.0 GPU-hours. The cancellation says the owner eventually concluded it was not worth running; the 21.5 hours before that is how long the cards were held while nobody was looking. For scale, the median cancelled job showing this little activity is killed within minutes -- this rule reports the tail, not normal behaviour. It does not distinguish a job that hung from one whose owner walked away, and the remedy differs: the first wants a liveness check, the second wants a notification.
findings.impactDescription: 43.0 GPU-hours allocated and not computed on.

findings.shortDescription: Interactive session held 1 GPU for 11.0h at 0.0% utilization
findings.longDescription: Interactive job 67023695504 stayed open for 11.0 hours holding 1 GPU at a mean SM utilization of 0.0%, and ended FAILED. An interactive session is a person at a keyboard; this long at this level of activity is a session that was not being used. The remedy is an idle-timeout on interactive allocations rather than anything about the workload.

findings.shortDescription: Job held 2 GPUs at 0.0% for 22.9h before it was cancelled
findings.longDescription: Job 67030494714 ran for 22.9 hours at a mean SM utilization of 0.0% and was then CANCELLED, consuming 45.9 GPU-hours. The cancellation says the owner eventually concluded it was not worth running; the 22.9 hours before that is how long the cards were held while nobody was looking. For scale, the median cancelled job showing this little activity is killed within minutes -- this rule reports the tail, not normal behaviour. It does not distinguish a job that hung from one whose owner walked away, and the remedy differs: the first wants a liveness check, the second wants a notification.
findings.impactDescription: 45.9 GPU-hours allocated and not computed on.
